specialLock.prompt: I am tall when I am young, and I am short when I am old. What am I?

trap.name: Poison Needle
trap.description: A dry needle hides beneath the latch.

customItems.name: True Lantern Wick
customItems.description: A cool blue wick that reveals which flames are honest and which are hungry.
customItems.customDescription: A cool blue wick that reveals which flames are honest and which are hungry.

intro.text: A desert shrine sends a blue lantern bobbing through the night. Locals say it guides lost children home. The last three search parties followed it into the same ruin and came back with their shadows missing.

outro.text: The true wick gutters in your pack, and every false flame in the ruin folds inward like a closed eye. The lantern is not dead, exactly. It is finally telling the truth.

storyTriggers.title: Moon-Silt Stair
storyTriggers.text: Moonlight collects on the steps like water. A lantern glows below, then turns away as if embarrassed to be caught waiting.

storyTriggers.title: Pilgrim Shade Hall
storyTriggers.text: Shadows kneel along the walls without bodies to cast them. Each one holds both hands out, asking for a light it no longer trusts.

storyTriggers.title: Dry Well of Echoes
storyTriggers.text: The dry well repeats anything spoken near it, but the echo always changes one word. It is trying to teach you the answer.

storyTriggers.title: The Honest Flame
storyTriggers.text: The crystal opens around the word like ice melting backward. Inside rests a wick that burns blue and cold.

storyTriggers.title: Lantern Sepulcher
storyTriggers.text: The Grave-Lantern Specter turns its cage of light toward you. Its flame shows your faces older, kinder, and already buried.

designNotes.twist: The guiding lantern is a liar until the party recovers its true wick.
designNotes.revision: Expanded to seven rooms and roughly 5-8 encounter rooms; hidden doors are one-sided from reachable rooms only.
